narr: The remnants of Hurricane Ida produced widespread heavy rainfall across Pennsylvania. Additionally, thunderstorms were observed southeast Of I-81 and the PA Turnpike. One of these storms produced wind damage in Adams County.
ev: Flash flooding was reported across the county with many roads closed. Roads affected by flooding include Route 3027 (Beavertown Road) from the intersection of Sugar Run Road to the intersection New Fording Road in Todd Township; Route 103 from the intersection of Arrowhead Way to the intersection of Bilger Road in Shirley Township; Route 522 at the intersection of Keystone Road to the intersection of Aughwick Mills Road in Shirley Township; Route 305 from the beginning of Route 305 to the intersection of Alexandria Pike in Porter Township; Route 3003 (Power Plant Road) from the Bedford County Line to the intersection of River Road in Hopewell Township; Route 2016 (Valley Street/Chester Furnace Road) from the intersection of Monroe Valley Road to the intersection of Clark Road in Cromwell Township; Route 522 at the intersection of Keystone Road to the intersection of Aughwick Mills Road in Shirley Township; Route 103 from the intersection of Arrowhead Way to the intersection of Bilger Road in Shirley Township; Route 4005 (Alexandria Pike/Pike Street) from the intersection of River road to the intersection of Berwick Forge Road in Porter Township; Route 3027 (Beavertown Road) from the intersection of Sugar Run Road to the intersection New Fording Road in Todd Township; Route 1017 (Martin Gap Road) from the intersection of Toner Camp Road to the intersection of Old Town Road in Miller Township; Route 1008 (Myton Road) from the intersection of 305 (Shavers Creek Road) to the intersection of Hughes Road in West Township; Route 3043 (Snyder Run Road) from the intersection of Snyder Run Road in Juniata Township to the intersection of Henderson Overlook in Smithfield Township.

A large number of localized flooding events were reported. Two water rescues were reported in Lickdale and Bethel Townships. Vehicle in flood waters reported at South Zellers Road and South Sheridan Road in Millcreek Township. No injuries were reported across the county.

Widespread flash flooding all over the region with water rescues reported. US 22 was closed in both directions in the Hollidaysburg area. Approximately 80 homes were impacted by flooding in the Altoona area. Widespread flash flooding reported. On the PA Turnpike flash flooding was reported at mile marker 135 with a large portion of the turnpike closed during the afternoon.

Numerous flooding, with water rescues reported across Dauphin County. Some areas that reported flash flooding include Hockensville Road and Hannover Street in South Hanover Township, areas near the Hershey Country Club at Derry Road, Richardson Road in Lower Swatara Township, Swatara Creek Park in South Hanover Township, McCorkle Road between Jacobs Creek and Church Road, Church Road between Laurie Avenue and Ney Road, Wood Road between Bullfrog Valley Road to Limeric, Eby Road from Meadow Lane to Royal Road, SR743 between Lingle Avenue and Bindnagle Road, Bachmanville Road between Meadow Road and Felty Mill Road. A mobile home park near Highspire was also evacuated due to flooding.

Flash flooding with road closures reported across Cumberland County. Some roads reported flooded include Steigerwalt Hollow Road and Lewisberry Road, Walnut Bottom Road in Carlisle between South West Street and South College Street, and PA114 in both directions between Poplar Road, Springers Lane and Old York Road in Fairview Township.

Significant flash flooding reported across York County. The NWS issued a Flash Flood Emergency at the request of the county when water rescues increased during the evening rush hour. 27 water rescues were reported. Tyler Run Creek at York College overflowed its banks, and several homes were submerged in water. Several roads sustained damage from flooding, including Valley Road in Newberry Township, West College Avenue in West Manchester Township, Indian Rock Dam Road in West Manchester Township, Iron Ridge Road between Old Hanover Road and Route 116 in Heidelberg Township and West Canal Road in Paradise Township. In Goldsboro, damage to Valley and Pines Roads was reported.
